title: Failures Are Fated, But Can Be Faded: Characterizing and Mitigating Unwanted Behaviors in Large-Scale Vision and Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using a deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent to explore prompt combinations (attributes, professions, places) and evaluating the resulting text-to-image generations for skewed male-to-female representation ratios using human feedback and CLIP embeddings.

Collecting human feedback scores (on a scale of 1 to 10) on text-to-image model outputs to evaluate perceived biases related to race and skin tone across various generated professional and social scenarios.
